text:
priya (ml): Quick sync — bringing the new model bridge (qbridge-4b -> qbridge-4b-int4) online. Before canary we need: prompt pruning rules, a golden microset, and a quant-compat eval run. Found ~3.2% prompt overlap after naive fingerprint dedupe.

anika (eng-ml): Can you share the overlap distribution? is it long-tail duplicates or concentrated? :eyes:

priya (ml): Mostly long-tail paraphrases + repeated boilerplate. Top clusters are docs snippets and API examples. I ran embedding-dedupe with cosine threshold 0.88 and then a stricter text-hash step.

jon (curation): For pruning, we should avoid removing edge-case prompts that surface regressions. Proposal: only prune within exact-cluster if cluster size > 5 and variance in labels < 0.02. Otherwise mark for manual review.

devon (label ops): Bandwidth check — labeling team can do manual review for ~800 items this week if we stagger batches of 200/day. Do we want L1 sanitize or full golden relabel?

sam (prod-mle): We need quantitative gates for canary: token-level logprob delta, rerank AUC, and hallucination rate. My proposal: no >0.8% drop in top-1 accuracy on golden microset, hallucination delta <0.5pp, and mean latency increase <5ms.

priya (ml): Sounds good. Plan: offline sim on 2k curated prompts (mix of golden + high-variance candidates), then a 5% microcanary with traffic routing. If passes, scale to 25% with fallback to qbridge-4b-fp16.

jon (curation): I'll assemble the micro-golden subset. Want a balance: 600 golden (previously verified), 700 edgecases flagged, 700 random tail. Will exclude prompts with PII flags. ETA 48h.

devon (label ops): We'll prioritize the 700 edgecases for relabeling. Request: export as CSV with columns: id, prompt, prev_labels, cluster_id. We can append labeler notes column.

priya (ml): Export format ok. Also adding a quick dedupe + pruning snippet I used for the initial pass:```sql
-- embedding dedupe: cluster by nearest neighbor cosine >= 0.88
WITH emb AS (SELECT id, embed_vector FROM prompts)
SELECT p.id, cluster_id FROM clusterize(emb, 0.88) p;
-- follow-up text hash filter: keep one per sha256(prompt) unless cluster_size > 5 and var(label) > 0.02
```

anika (eng-ml): For the quant-compat eval harness, please include the exact tokenization used at serving (tokenizer v2) and run both int4 and fp16 passes. We want side-by-side outputs and logprobs exported.

sam (prod-mle): Also add a rerank pass using the production ranking model; we need delta distributions, not just means. Plot tails.

rollout-bot: Canary checklist created: tasks assigned -> curation:jon, labeling:devon, eval:sam/priya. Cron job scheduled for offline sim tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

jon (curation): Quick q: do we accept pruning suggestions automatically for clusters made solely of short-form prompts (<20 tokens)? My inclination is yes for clusters >10 size.

priya (ml): Agree for short-form clusters >10, auto-prune to retain representative 2 per cluster, mark others as "pruned-auto" with provenance tags. For longer prompts keep candidates for manual review.

devon (label ops): Noted. We'll only relabel the 700 edgecases; auto-pruned items get archived and can be rehydrated if eval shows regressions.

anika (eng-ml): Timeline check: jon 48h for microset, devon label batch next 5 business days, offline sim tomorrow, microcanary after sim + gating (~72h after labels). OK?

priya (ml): Yep. I'll post the eval scripts and results in this thread once offline sim completes.

sam (prod-mle): Final gate: if top-1 accuracy drop on golden >0.5% we abort and open regression ticket. Otherwise proceed with gradual ramp.

priya (ml): Assigning follow-ups: jon -> micro-golden CSV (due 48h), devon -> labeler queue + relabel plan, anika -> validate eval harness tokenizer parity, sam -> define rerank tail metric. I'll run offline sim and post logs. :+1:

rollout-bot: Offline sim job started (job_id: offline-sim-6161616161). Will post results on completion.
